title.value: A Multi-Domain VNE Algorithm based on Load Balancing in the IoT networks
title.justification: The title of the paper is stated at the beginning of the manuscript and summarizes the primary topic discussed in the paper.
title.quote: A Multi-Domain VNE Algorithm based on Load Balancing in the IoT networks

extractions.description: The paper proposes a virtual network embedding (VNE) strategy utilizing a hybrid genetic algorithm to address network virtualization issues in the Internet of Things (IoT) environments. The strategy aims to enhance flexibility and performance in heterogeneous networks with large traffic. It introduces dynamic crossover probability, pheromone-based mutation gene selection, and a weight update mechanism focused on load balancing. The approach targets improvements in mapping cost-benefit ratio, acceptance rate, and load balancing within IoT networks using hybrid algorithms combining genetic and ant colony techniques. Simulation results are provided to evaluate performance.
